How To Join Games

What Is Vanilla Civ Mod (kekmod)?

The vanilla Civ 5 mod (kekmod) is a lightweight mod that enables competitive play with fair rules and bugfixes. It is required for all games on this server.

)} {selectedTab === 2 && ( <>

30 sec Install & Uninstall Guide for Mod

  1. Download the mod from our Discord #mod-downloads channel.
  2. Extract the .civ5mod file to your Civ 5 MODS folder.
  3. Enable the mod in-game before joining a lobby.
  4. To uninstall, simply delete the mod file from the MODS folder.
